metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the call, the book staying through Thursday, and the page on the uncles.

yesterday: Field named the gap. The Holinshed is in daily use. The cat reads only the second volume. The chronicle stays upstairs.
Sunday is dinner, after sermon. Jacqueline has a hen. The comedy goes if Garnish looses it, and Field will read it.
You are not in today's Shrew. Wednesday you are in it. Thursday is the comedy. Saturday the Shrew again.
The licensed book stays in Garnish's hand through Thursday.
The uncles are still as fine as the nephew. Tomorrow is the difference.
